finding.title: Buffer Overflow or Out-of-bounds Write
finding.trigger: address is outside the valid range of PPU registers
finding.assumptions: The function does not validate that 'address' is within the valid range of PPU registers. If an attacker can control the 'address' parameter, they could write to arbitrary memory locations.
